address: Sitio de Pocinho, Vila Nova de Cacela, 8901-907, Portugal
bio: (Temporarily closed) We find ourselves in a luxury resort (Monte Rei Golf & Country Club) in the eastern Algarve, where they say the best golf course in Portugal can be found, and which deserves a range of cuisine to match! The elegant dining room, in a classic style with large windows overlooking the surrounding greenery, boasts just a few impeccably set tables, along with one reserved for private dining in the kitchen area.
